name: list_destinations
description: Retrieves details of all Destinations in your team, including their identifier, name, connector, status, and configuration settings. Credentials in the configuration settings are masked. The Destinations are ordered by `id`. A Destination that you have deleted, or that is being deleted, is not listed. The response lists only the Destinations in the region of the base URL that you call.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value used to retrieve the next set of results. Provide the `next_cursor` value returned in the previous API response.
Maximum number of results the API should return. If not set, the API returns up to 100 items.
parameters.name: limit

code.description: Status of the API call. Returns `Success` for a successful request.

name.description: Name of the Destination in Hevo.

connector_id.description: Identifier of the connector that loads data into this Destination. This is the `connector_id` value that the Destination was created with. For example, _snowflake_.

type.description: Type of the Destination. This is the `type` value that the Destination was created with. For example, _SNOWFLAKE_.

x-enumDescriptions.CREATED: The Destination is ready to receive data.
x-enumDescriptions.FAILED: Hevo created the Destination but could not complete its setup. You cannot use a Destination in this status in a Pipeline. Delete it and create it again.

config.description: Configuration settings of the Destination, with credentials masked. The settings returned depend on the connector. Refer to [Read the Connector Configuration](/reference/creating-destinations-with-hevo-api#step-1-read-the-connector-configuration) for more information about the settings that each connector accepts.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Destination was created, in Unix epoch time (in milliseconds).

created_by.description: Email address of the user who created the Destination.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Destination was last updated, in Unix epoch time (in milliseconds).

updated_by.description: Email address of the user who last updated the Destination.

next_cursor.description: Value you can use to fetch the next set of results. Specify this value in the `cursor` query parameter to fetch additional results. This is `null` when no more results are available.

has_more.description: Indicates whether more results are available.
